assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready transparent sprite sheet for STAR_BOUNCE, a cute cozy space-adventure ball game. 1536x1536 square PNG, true transparent alpha background. EXACT rigid 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 equally spaced square cells. Each row is one ORIGINAL spacecraft repeated in four matching animation frames, changing only the engine exhaust pulse and tiny running lights. Orthographic top-down view, nose points EXACTLY RIGHT in every cell, engine at LEFT, identical position and size in each row, no banking, no perspective change. Row 1: cream and orange compact interceptor with three swept fins and blue engines; row 2: chunky slate teal cargo freighter with side cargo pods and warm amber engines; row 3: plum and silver small exploration probe craft with rounded wings and green engines; row 4: elegant silver indigo long escort cruiser with two compact engine nacelles and violet engines. Retro cinematic space opera atmosphere, detailed toy-like painted metal, soft rounded silhouettes, readable at 100px, cheerful rather than aggressive. Each complete craft including exhaust fits inside central 66% width and 52% height of its cell, with large EMPTY transparent gutters. Consistent scale within rows, each craft centered. Sharp clean alpha edges, no cast ground shadow, no grid lines, no letters, no text, no logo, no backdrop, no stars. Original ship silhouettes, not replicas of named movie spacecraft. Animation: exhaust short, medium, bright long, medium; running lights pulse subtly. All four rows must contain FOUR frames and never merge neighboring cells.

prompts: Edit the supplied spacecraft reference into a transparent production game sprite sheet. Use ONLY the large TOP VIEW spacecraft in the LEFT panel of the reference, preserving its recognizable Millennium Falcon silhouette, forked nose, side cockpit, dish, weathered gray panel detail and proportions. Remove the reference background, all labels, side views, logos, landing gear and layout. Output 1024x1024 RGBA PNG with a genuinely transparent background, EXACT 2 columns x 2 rows = FOUR equal square animation cells. Rotate the top-down ship so the forked NOSE points EXACTLY RIGHT, rear engine LEFT, in EVERY frame. Ship centered in each cell, identical scale and alignment; full ship and glow within central 68% width and 68% height, generous empty transparent margins. Frame order left to right then next row: blue rear engine glow short/dim, medium, brighter/longer, medium. Only engine glow and tiny lights change, no rotation or hull movement between frames. Keep complete original top-down hull intact. Clean antialiased alpha edges, no ground shadow, no added characters, no text, no grid. This is for a local game prototype using the user's supplied asset.

Edit this four-frame transparent Falcon sprite sheet ONLY to correct spacing and alignment for game animation. Keep the exact detailed spacecraft design, top-down right-facing orientation and blue engine animation. STRICT 2x2 equal cells, square 1280x1280 image. Each 640x640 cell must have the same hull centered at cell center (320,320) with the same scale. Shrink every ship so the entire craft plus blue glow occupies at most 430 pixels width and 360 pixels height per 640x640 cell. All four complete hulls fully inside their own cells with wide clear transparent gutters; no pixels touching outer edges or neighboring cells. Remove the current vertical and horizontal jitter between frames. The ship's center position and hull size must be identical across all four frames; only the blue glow varies. True transparent alpha background, no background color, no labels, no extra details.
